name: CIB seven AI Agent (ad hoc sub process)
description: Makes an ad hoc sub process agentic: the agent is configuration on this element, its child activities are the tools, and each turn runs as a job on the scope.

properties.label: Agent name
properties.description: Names the agent in log lines and audit events. Defaults to the id of this element.

properties.label: Message
properties.description: The task for the agent. Sent at the start of every turn.

properties.label: Instruction
properties.description: System message. Say what the agent is for and when it should end the scope.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Process variable the agent's answer is written to at the end of every turn.

properties.label: Model
properties.description: Leave empty to take the engine's connector configuration.

properties.label: Base URL
properties.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. Leave empty to take the engine's configuration.

properties.label: API key
properties.description: Leave empty to take the engine's configuration or the environment.

properties.label: Reasoning effort
properties.description: For models that support it: low, medium, high.

properties.label: Max model calls per turn
properties.description: Tool calls allowed within one turn. Default 25. A value that is not a positive number falls back to the default.

properties.label: Max turns
properties.description: Turns allowed before the agent must stop. Default 10.

properties.label: Additional tool classes
properties.description: Comma-separated @Tool classes, on top of the ad hoc tool. The child activities of this scope are already the agent's tools; AdHocSubProcessTool is added automatically and does not belong here.

properties.label: MCP servers
properties.description: JSON array of MCP server configs: [{"name": "...", "url": "...", "headers": {...}}].
